{{Quote|We're approaching the junction of the Braxant Run, Generals. We'll be jumping to hyperspace momentarily.|A [[Unidentified clone trooper captain (Order 66)|clone trooper captain]] to [[K'Kruhk]] and [[Sian Jeisel]]|<ref name="Dark Times 6">[[Dark Times 6|''Dark Times'' 6]]</ref>}}
The '''Braxant Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the most important of the northern quadrant. The hyperlane began as branch of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] at [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]], where it soon passed through the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]] and the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]] before reaching [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] scouts kept as a commercial secret their extension of the route into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TEA" />

By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Braxant Run was frequently used by [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] operating out of [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]].<ref name="GatORW" />
